name: Ultimate X
summary: Multi-hand video poker where a winning hand leaves a multiplier on the same line for the next deal. Multipliers left by a previous player are visible on screen.

facts.label: Feature bet
facts.value: 10 coins per hand turns the feature on

facts.label: Persistent state
facts.value: A paying hand earns a multiplier for the next hand in the same position

facts.label: Entry threshold
facts.value: No published threshold table found. Forum rules of thumb exist but are not used here.

preserve.reason: Double bet per hand and large swings

return.reason: Return depends on the base paytable; not in the rulebook

state.reason: Visible state, but no sourced entry rule yet

inputs.label: Next hand — total of all multipliers showing
